item.title: Shinyscholar - a template for creating reproducible shiny apps
item.description: I'm the developer of this package and am giving a workshop about it next month in case anyone is interested in learning more: [https://sites.google.com/view/dariia-mykhailyshyna/main/r-workshops-for-ukraine#h.svl2ujruwf92](https://sites.google.com/view/dariia-mykhailyshyna/main/r-workshops-for-ukraine#h.svl2ujruwf92) It enables producing shiny apps to conduct complex analyses which are also fully reproducible outside of the app. Other features include being able to load/save at any point, a flexible logging system and guidance for users.
